plain.li: [greetings,warm,their:pilgrims] Your letter was read aloud at the shrine tonight, {WRITER}, and every pilgrim in the hostel said a word for your colony.
[greetings,cordial,their:pilgrims] The fellowship has your letter. Any pilgrim of ours who passes your gate will ask after you by name.
[greetings,cool,their:pilgrims] The fellowship has your letter. The road is long, and there is time yet to know one another.
[news,warm,their:pilgrims] Half the region walks past our shrines in a year, {WRITER}, and tells us everything at supper. Here is the best of it.
[news,cordial,their:pilgrims] Pilgrims come to us from every road, and they talk. This is what the hostel has heard.
[help,warm,their:pilgrims] The fellowship owns little, but what it has is shared. What you asked for is coming with our palmers.
[help,cordial,their:pilgrims] We are poor in everything but company, but we will send what we can. It is coming.
[help,refusal,their:pilgrims] The hostel feeds more mouths this season than it can, {WRITER}. There is nothing left to send, and we are sorry for it.
[invitation,warm,their:pilgrims] A pilgrim never turns from an open door. We will come, and bring a blessing.
[greetings,warm,their:scholars] Your letter has been read, copied and filed in the archive, {WRITER}, which is the highest honour the society knows.
[greetings,cordial,their:scholars] The society thanks you for your letter. A copy of it is in the archive now, with your colony's other records.
[greetings,cool,their:scholars] The society has your letter. We keep everything, even letters from colonies we know little of.
[news,warm,their:scholars] The archive hears from every town that writes anything down, {WRITER}. Here is what the season's letters say.
[news,cordial,their:scholars] Our copyists go everywhere and forget nothing. This is what they brought back.
[help,warm,their:scholars] The society does not lend from its stores as a rule, but it does for friends of the archive. It is coming with our copyists.
[help,cordial,their:scholars] It is irregular, and the provost will want it noted, but the society can spare it. It is coming.
[help,refusal,their:scholars] The archive's money has gone on paper and the roof this year, {WRITER}. We have nothing to send.
[invitation,warm,their:scholars] A fellow of the society will come with a notebook, and stay as long as anyone will talk.
[greetings,warm,their:brokers] Your message reached the exchange, {WRITER}, and the chair has marked your colony as a preferred account.
[greetings,cordial,their:brokers] The enclave acknowledges your message. Your colony is on the factors' route.
[greetings,cool,their:brokers] The enclave has your message. Trade with us, and the terms will improve.
[news,warm,their:brokers] Prices, routes and rumours from orbit, {WRITER}, as the exchange has them this week.
[news,cordial,their:brokers] The ships above see more than the towns below. Here is what the enclave's factors know.
[help,warm,their:brokers] The enclave does not give credit lightly, but your account is good. What you asked for is coming with our runners.
[help,cordial,their:brokers] Consider it an advance against future trade. It is on its way.
[help,refusal,their:brokers] The exchange cannot extend credit this quarter, {WRITER}. The ledgers do not allow it.
[invitation,warm,their:brokers] A factor will come down for it, and bring samples.
[greetings,warm,their:fishers] Your words came downriver with the boats, {WRITER}, and the whole landing heard them over the fish stew.
[greetings,cordial,their:fishers] The river folk have your words. Any boat of ours will put in for your people.
[greetings,cool,their:fishers] We have your words. The river will tell us whether to trust them.
[news,warm,their:fishers] Everyone talks on a ferry, {WRITER}, and we carry everyone. Here is what we heard.
[news,cordial,their:fishers] Everything comes down the river in the end, the news with it. Here is what the boats brought.
[help,warm,their:fishers] The river was kind this season, and we share what it gives. It is coming up with our boatmen.
[help,warm,food,their:fishers] The racks are full and the smokehouse fuller. Some of it is coming to you with our boatmen.
[help,refusal,their:fishers] The water was low and the fish few this season, {WRITER}. We have nothing to send.
[invitation,warm,their:fishers] We will come up from the landing, and bring a basket from the river.
[arrive,their:pilgrims] Peace on this house, I walked here from the shrine.
[leave,their:pilgrims] The road is long, so I had better be on it.
[arrive,their:scholars] A letter from the archive, copied twice in case.
[leave,their:scholars] The archive will want to know I got here.
[arrive,their:brokers] Message from the exchange, carried by hand for you.
[deliver,silver,their:brokers] Enclave credit, settled in silver as agreed.
[leave,their:brokers] My pickup won't wait, so I'll be going.
[arrive,their:fishers] Up from the landing with word from the river master.
[collect,food,their:fishers] The landing will eat well on this.
[leave,their:fishers] The boat's tied up below, and the river's rising.
[opt0] Pilgrims came to the gate at dusk and we took them in. I sat up with their eldest, who has walked to more shrines than I can count.
[opt0] We gave a band of pilgrims a corner each for the night. They talk about the road the way other people talk about home.
[opt1] Pilgrims asked to sleep under our roof tonight. They are outside the gate instead, and I can see their shapes from the wall.
[opt2] We kept the gate shut on a band of pilgrims. They bowed to it anyway.

warm.li: [opt0] {X_nameDef}, the eldest of the pilgrims, asked my name before bed so the fellowship could pray for me by it.

gloomy.li: [opt2] Pilgrims at the gate tonight, and we sent them on. I keep thinking about the dark road.

plain.li: [opt0] A copyist of the learned society spent the day copying our records, and asked me about every page. We have a {THING} from their archive for it.
[opt0] Our records are in an archive now, in somebody else's careful hand. Strange to think of strangers reading what we did.
[opt1] {X_nameDef} copied our records and showed me how the society keeps its own. I have ideas about ours now.
[opt2] A scholar wanted to copy our records. We said no. They are ours.

warm.li: [opt0] {X_nameDef} said our records are better kept than most. I did not know we kept them that well.

cold.li: [opt0] A book in exchange for copying some pages. A fair trade.
